description: This file defines the CategoryService interface, which declares methods for managing categories in an e-commerce application, including retrieval, addition, and counting of categories based on various criteria.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on store and lineage string, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store and search engine URL, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches the description of a category for a specific language, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent category, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by parent category, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories for a store filtered by parent category, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store, name, and language, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories in a store, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Gets a category by store and code, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStoreAndLanguage
methods.description: Lists categories for a store filtered by language, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on store code and lineage string, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Gets a category by store code and category code, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Get category by store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by parent with optional language filtering.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID and language.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns counts of products per categories in a store based on category IDs, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Lists categories by store, list of codes, and language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Lists categories by store, list of IDs, and language.
